name: Retry Assurance
description: Check whether retrying your .NET job creates duplicate work.
features: Real C# operation callbacks and a maintained synthetic JSON POST/jobs scenario
Server-derived results from durable resources, request sequence and key relationships
Immutable behavior revisions, scenario hashes and separate before/after runs
Actual accounts, project roles, one-use invitations and revocable runner capabilities
Destination-bound transport, synthetic credentials and allowlisted evidence exports
Independent Blazor portal, runnable broken/correct clients and portable source
Usable free allowance with optional signed-provider billing after owner configuration
businessHypothesis: API providers maintaining a .NET job client may pay for maintained failure semantics and repeatable release verification. The proposed USD 99 monthly Team plan expands actual account limits; checkout requires merchant, exact-plan and signed-notification configuration. Live payments, willingness to pay and customer adoption remain unverified. Private projects and execution evidence do not load advertising trackers.
